Class XC6V

java.lang.Object
threepl.netlist.TDECode
threepl.netlist.GenFunctions
threepl.netlist.xilinx.XElements
threepl.netlist.xilinx.XFunctions
threepl.netlist.xilinx.XTDECode
threepl.netlist.xilinx.XC6V
All Implemented Interfaces:
TDEConstants, NetConstants, Constant
public class XC6V extends XTDECode implements NetConstants

This class implements Xilinx library elements particular to Virtex 6 FPGAs. These are low level elements from which the output EDIF netlist is generated. All higher level functions call these, directly or indirectly.
